item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00246","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C22","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 is a highly plausible drafting template: it concerns extensions of statutory deadlines for temporary housing under the Housing and Home Finance Administrator and repeatedly uses the same operative formula, “The time stipulated in [statutory provision] ... is extended to [date].” The child applies that concrete machinery to section 313 and changes the removal deadline to July 1, 1954—a date also central to C17’s temporary-housing provisions. C22 is an earlier version of substantially the same extension framework but is less proximate and uses earlier deadlines. C05 shares the housing agency and subject area but employs different administrative-transfer machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The time stipulated in section 313 of the said act ... within which ... housing of a temporary character under the jurisdiction of the Housing and Home Finance Administration ... must be removed is hereby extended ... to July 1, 1954.","parent_excerpt":"The time stipulated in section 604 of the Act ... prior to which the premises must be vacated is extended to July 1, 1954.","explanation":"Both extend a statutory deadline governing the disposition or removal of temporary housing to the identical terminal date using closely parallel operative language."},{"child_excerpt":"The time stipulated in section 313 ... is hereby extended","parent_excerpt":"The time stipulated in section 604 of the Act ... is extended","explanation":"This is a concrete shared drafting formula, adapted by substituting the statutory section and the particular housing-removal obligation."}]}
